headline: No API changes break the bot today and research was thin, so there are two ideas: drop movers whose volume came from one burst, and show in /week how the trades you took against the scanner's own warnings did.

ideas.title: Steady-volume check on each mover
ideas.why: A coin can pass the 24h volume floor from one burst and be thin the rest of the day. Count how many of the last 96 15m candles cleared a set dollar volume and flag 'Patchy' below about 80%. Fewer jumpy coins to chase, using candles the scanner already pulls.

ideas.title: Warnings you traded through, in /week
ideas.why: Save the scanner's flags (Crowded, Stretched, OI falling, vs BTC, Late) for each coin when you open a trade. /week then shows trades taken on flagged coins vs clean ones, with P&L. If flagged trades lose, you see it in your own numbers, not as a rule.
